report:
**Sample adequacy:** 1 field analysed, 1 white cell counted — too few for a differential (under 20 and under 100 cells). Indicative counts: 14 red cells, 0 platelets.

**Differential:** 1 neutrophil (100% of counted cells). With only 1 cell the differential is only indicative and cannot be compared to reference ranges.

**Review list:** 1 cell in the review queue.
- Cell 1 (neutrophil, confidence 0.87) — flagged for verification.

**Limits:** Second-opinion model is generalist (65% on single cells, weaker on IG/erythroblasts) vs classifier 97.6%; red cells undercounted on crowded fields; reference ranges are indicative; blast class from single lab — suspected blasts are to review only.

known_limits: The second opinion model is a generalist: 65 % right on single PBC cells, weak on ig and erythroblasts (experiment 01). The classifier is 97.6 % right on the same data (experiment 05).
Red cells are undercounted on crowded fields (experiment 14); the red cell count is indicative.
Reference ranges are indicative adult ranges; the lab's own ranges prevail.
Blast class learnt from one lab only (Munich, experiment 19): 97 % of blasts found there, 3 % of other cells wrongly called blast. A suspected blast is a cell to look at, not a finding.
